All URLs point to the project's own declared upstream (`github.com/yetidevworks/reeve` and `raw.githubusercontent.com` for README/LICENSE). Nothing is downloaded or executed during this step. The `package()` body (which installs the prebuilt binary and docs into `$pkgdir`) is not executed by `--printsrcinfo` and is out of scope for this gate. Checksums are present and pinned; no SKIP is used.
</details>
<evidence>
